card.name: The word enough in opioid taper wording
card.fires_on: The word "enough" in the opioid label sentence "initiate the taper by a small enough increment", after "a small". All strong contexts are this same sentence, repeated across many opioid products.

modes.label: Taper increment wording
modes.description: "enough" follows "a small" in the instruction on starting an opioid taper for physically dependent patients.
